card: This PR optimizes legacy wallet migration to SQLite by skipping legacy records and transaction records during the initial copy pass rather than writing and then erasing them. Because descriptor records replace legacy entries and transaction records are rewritten later in migration, omitting them upfront avoids redundant database writes. Removing these erase steps allows dropping unused database deletion routines (EraseTx, RemoveTxs, DeleteRecordsWithDB, EraseRecords) and privatizing HasLegacyRecords within walletdb.cpp. It has no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or commit structure; the PR appears to have undergone a routine rebase.
evidence: PR description: "The legacy wallet records are replaced with descriptor records produced during migration, and transaction records are already being rewritten by migration, so not writing them in the first place is also fine. This allows us to remove several database record erase functions, specifically EraseTx and EraseRecords."
problem: Legacy wallet migration dumps all BDB records into a new SQLite database, only for subsequent steps to immediately erase legacy key/script records and delete or overwrite transaction records. This incurs unnecessary disk I/O and keeps dead record-erasure code paths in the wallet.

risk.why: A flaw in skipping records during migration could cause migrated SQLite wallets to omit needed records or fail migration.

summary: Updates the legacy-to-SQLite wallet migration process to skip copying legacy records and transaction records upfront rather than copying and subsequently erasing them. Because migration generates replacement descriptor records and rewrites all transactions, filtering these record types during MigrateToSQLite avoids redundant database disk writes. With the deletion step removed, the PR deletes several unused database erase helpers (EraseTx, RemoveTxs, DeleteRecordsWithDB, EraseRecords) and makes HasLegacyRecords static to walletdb.cpp.
